imports.review: Complete quiet right-facing shadow silhouette: elongated featureless head, narrow torso, two drooping arms, two small legs and foot tips. The targeted imagegen correction changes pale mist to dark charcoal material with genuine translucent interior. No face, clothing, weapon, muscular detail or source-room texture appears.
imports.limits: The original scene is oblique; the new side thickness is inferred and the capture region remains unspecified. Opacity and blur are authored, not measured from the 1999 renderer; visibility against the atelier background requires integration review. A soft shadow has no exact hard sole. The anchor and body envelope are provisional presentation calibration. No combat enabling, source animation, original timing or one-to-one fidelity is claimed. Requested 12 percent padding is not met vertically; all readable head/limb tips remain inside the canvas.

Entire upper/lower lattice and corner posts fit; open gaps have genuine alpha zero. No walking limbs, separate victim or Wall Corpse metal blades added.
imports.limits: Only a 300 by 300 native render is available: lateral cage depth, concealed attachments and fine surface marks remain inferred, not verified. Requested 12 percent padding was not met vertically: about 8.3 percent, with the entire cage still inside the canvas. The regularized cage projection is a new presentation angle, not a measured model extraction. One static atelier reference; no combat enabling, new movement or original timing is claimed.

imports.review: Right-facing full lateral figure retains the tall ceremonial hat, orange face, violet robe, extremely long hair, full low chain and complete visible shoe. The far shoe is naturally occluded by the robe and near leg; no extra leg is invented.
imports.limits: Source concept includes a profile but surface details, chain drape and hidden-side geometry remain reconstructed. Fine low-alpha hair fringe and chain lie slightly below the visible shoe sole. No source timing or one-to-one fidelity is certified. Requested 10 percent padding is not reached on every side; measured minimum alpha8 padding is 4.58 percent, with no readable silhouette cut. Low-alpha native noise is retained byte-for-byte; no trim, rescale, recoloring or alpha cleanup was applied.

imports.review: Profil droit entier de Lunger, debout : tête organique asymétrique à bord noir intégré, deux bras repliés retenus par les sangles, doigts retenus près du torse, deux jambes minces et deux pieds complets dirigés à droite. Aucun poing libre, arme tenue, membre supplémentaire ou fond opaque visible. La lecture latérale du torse est étroite et cohérente avec les pieds.
imports.limits: Les trajets et le nombre précis des sangles/boucles ne sont pas mesurés ; leur construction latérale reste approximative. Marges verticales très réduites (8 px au-dessus et 19 px au-dessous du seuil alpha8) : les extrémités sont entières, mais la cible de marge généreuse du prompt n’est pas atteinte. Un bruit alpha1 existe au bord ; aucun sujet visible ne touche ce bord. Reconstruction statique guidée par les références ; aucun profil source exact, côté opposé, modèle tournant ou timing original disponible. Le côté caché, l’épaisseur, les surfaces et les petites asymétries sont reconstruits. Fidélité unverified, sans certification 1:1. Le miroir est une présentation uniquement. Les ancres et hauteurs sont des propositions à contrôler dans le moteur ; elles ne certifient pas l’échelle canonique. Aucun nouveau portrait, clip animé ou changement de rôle.

imports.review: One complete slender Widow facing right in a strict lateral silhouette. Pale rounded face-covering draped hood, original gray ragged wraps, hanging rectangular photo/paper pieces and trailing cloth bands retained. One short flat wood strip held low, two attached arms, two complete bare legs and feet. No black funeral veil, knife or invented weapon. Whole hood, wood, bands, fingertips, heels and toes inside the canvas.
imports.limits: Model03 is a named whole-body three-quarter source, not a measured lateral turnaround. The new profile and more level resting foot presentation reconstruct unseen depth and pose; hood folds, covered face outline, strip/photo placement and exact anatomy remain unverified. Widow remains unverified and outside duel; this image does not establish attacks, mobility, a combat pattern or super. A 20% empty margin was requested; actual minimum visible padding is 10.77%. No readable extremity is clipped. Native trace alpha is preserved. One static candidate only, no animated clip, no source timing, no UHD or 1:1 certification.
